title: Tetrahedral Mesh Verification Receipt
description: Schema for verification receipts emitted by the Tetrahedral Mesh Protocol verifier.

mesh_id.description: Identifier of the mesh that was verified.

cell_count.description: Number of tetrahedral cells in the mesh.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the receipt was emitted.

canonical_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical JSON serialisation of the mesh state.

prev_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the previous receipt in the chain, or null for the first receipt.

verifier_version.description: Version string of the TMP verifier that produced this receipt.

failures.description: List of failure descriptions when result is FAIL or ERROR.
